description: Configure a data governance workflow in DHIS2. Log in (admin/district) and navigate to the Maintenance app. Create two new Data Approval Levels: one for 'District Approval' (linked to the District organisation unit level) and one for 'National Approval' (linked to the National/Country organisation unit level). Then, create a Data Approval Workflow named 'Health Data Review Workflow' that includes these two levels with a Monthly period type. Finally, assign this new workflow to an existing aggregate dataset (e.g., 'Malaria Monthly' or similar) so that data entered for that dataset requires approval.
